text_a: Ana envió el archivo y Luis el informe.
text_b: Ana envió el archivo y Luis envió el informe.

text_a: Maria called the client and Tom too.
text_b: Maria called the client and Tom.
what_differs: A: Tom also called the client; B: Maria called both the client and Tom

text_a: Pedro revisou o contrato e a Júlia também.
text_b: Pedro e Júlia revisaram o contrato.

text_a: Juan quiere a Marta más que Pedro.
text_b: Juan loves Marta more than he loves Pedro.
what_differs: A can also mean Juan loves Marta more than Pedro loves Marta; B fixes the object reading

text_a: The invoice was sent two days ago.
text_b: The invoice went out the day before yesterday.

text_a: Llamé al proveedor ayer.
text_b: Llamé al proveedor el día anterior.
what_differs: ayer is anchored to today; el día anterior is anchored to some other reference day

text_a: A reunião é na próxima sexta.
text_b: A reunião é nesta sexta.
what_differs: próxima sexta may mean this coming Friday or the Friday of next week depending on speaker

text_a: Submit the form by tomorrow.
text_b: Submit the form within the next 24 hours.
what_differs: A deadline is the end of tomorrow; B is exactly 24 hours from now

text_a: La contraseña del router está en la etiqueta.
text_b: La etiqueta lleva escrita la contraseña del router.

text_a: The keys belong to Sarah.
text_b: Sarah has the keys.
what_differs: A is ownership; B is current physical possession

text_a: O motor faz parte da máquina.
text_b: O motor é um dos componentes da máquina.

text_a: Revisa el informe de Carlos.
text_b: Revisa el informe que escribió Carlos.
what_differs: de Carlos may mean written by, owned by, assigned to, or about Carlos

text_a: The phone number field is optional.
text_b: You may leave the phone number field blank.

text_a: Adjunta el certificado si lo tienes.
text_b: Adjunta el certificado si aplica.
what_differs: A conditions on availability; B conditions on applicability, so it may be required even if you lack it

text_a: Os campos marcados com asterisco são obrigatórios.
text_b: Only the fields marked with an asterisk are required.
what_differs: B adds exclusivity (all others optional); A says nothing about unmarked fields

text_a: A photo ID is recommended.
text_b: A photo ID is optional.
what_differs: Both make it non-mandatory, but recommended adds an expectation that optional lacks

text_a: Cierra la sesión al terminar.
text_b: Hay que cerrar la sesión al terminar.

text_a: The backup should be run every night.
text_b: The backup is run every night.
what_differs: A states an obligation; B describes what actually happens

text_a: Envie o relatório amanhã.
text_b: O relatório deve ser enviado amanhã.

text_a: Las contraseñas se cambian cada 90 días.
text_b: Las contraseñas deben cambiarse cada 90 días.
what_differs: A may describe automatic system behavior or state a policy; B is clearly an obligation

text_a: Install the driver before connecting the printer.
text_b: Connect the printer only after installing the driver.

text_a: Para publicar se requiere la aprobación del editor.
text_b: Publica después de que el editor lo revise.
what_differs: A requires approval; B only requires a review, which may end in rejection

text_a: O acesso ao sistema depende da assinatura do contrato.
text_b: Só é possível acessar o sistema depois de assinar o contrato.

text_a: Update the docs before the release.
text_b: The release depends on the docs being updated.
what_differs: A may be a soft ordering instruction; B makes the docs a blocking dependency

text_a: El grupo debe tener entre 3 y 5 personas, ambos incluidos.
text_b: El grupo debe tener como mínimo 3 personas y como máximo 5.

text_a: Orders of up to 10 units ship free.
text_b: Orders of fewer than 10 units ship free.
what_differs: A includes exactly 10 units; B excludes it

text_a: O desconto vale para pedidos acima de 100 reais.
text_b: El descuento aplica a pedidos de 100 reales o más.
what_differs: A excludes an order of exactly 100; B includes it

text_a: Choose a number between 1 and 10.
text_b: Choose a number from 1 to 10, inclusive.
what_differs: between may or may not include the endpoints 1 and 10

text_a: Save your changes to the same file you opened.
text_b: Overwrite the file you opened with your changes.

text_a: Envíame el archivo cuando esté listo.
text_b: Envíame un archivo cuando esté listo.
what_differs: A refers to a specific known file; B to an unspecified one

text_a: Qualquer funcionário pode aprovar a despesa.
text_b: Um funcionário pode aprovar a despesa.
what_differs: A grants permission to every employee; B only says some or one employee can

text_a: Usa la plantilla del mes pasado.
text_b: Usa la misma plantilla que el mes pasado.
what_differs: A may mean last month's filled-in document as a base, or just the same template type

text_a: Each participant must sign the form individually.
text_b: Every participant has to sign the form on their own.

text_a: Los tres técnicos levantaron la caja.
text_b: Cada uno de los tres técnicos levantó la caja.
what_differs: A allows a joint lift; B says each technician lifted it individually

text_a: Os candidatos serão entrevistados um por um.
text_b: Cada candidato será entrevistado individualmente, em sequência.

text_a: The two teams received $1,000.
text_b: Each team received $1,000.
what_differs: A can be $1,000 in total; B is $1,000 per team ($2,000 total)

text_a: La puerta debe permanecer cerrada.
text_b: La puerta tiene que quedarse cerrada.

text_a: The ticket was closed.
text_b: The ticket is closed.
what_differs: A reports a past closing event (it may have been reopened); B asserts the current state

text_a: A loja continua aberta até as 22h.
text_b: A loja permanece aberta até as 22h.

text_a: Registration opens on March 1.
text_b: La inscripción está abierta el 1 de marzo.
what_differs: A marks the start of an open period; B only asserts the open state on that single date
